in_marathi.name: Banwari
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Worshipper of Lord Vishnu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Banwari हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who dedicates himself to the worship of Lord Vishnu. Derived from the Sanskrit words 'Ban' (Worship) and 'Vari' (Lord Vishnu).
